svg.title: Adopting neat-os and the improvement loop
svg.desc: Adopt once: a person installs (pins a release tag), init (copy the templates into AGENTS.md and a .agents/ folder), gather (scan the repo plus a short interview). Then improve continuously in a loop: work, where agents follow it; learn drafts proposals; a person opens a PR to neat-os and a person merges it; a person tags a release on main; each product repo moves its own pin (new tag plus lockfile), then back to work. Releases do not flow back automatically. Grey cubes mark the steps a person does.
